parts.name: Root
parts.description: The scale, the value and the keyboard. It renders a div with role="radiogroup", or role="slider" at a precision below 1, named by Rating.Label.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable id, from which the component makes its internal ARIA ids. Give one on a server.

props.name: value
props.description: The value, from 0 to `count`. 0 is no rating. You can bind it with `bind:value`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value at the start, for when you give no `value`. The default is 0.

props.name: controlledValue
props.description:
Give your own code full control of the value. The component stops to write back to `value`,
and it reports only through `onChange`. Thus the parent can refuse a change.

props.name: onChange
props.description: The component calls it on each change.

props.name: onChangeEnd
props.description:
The component calls it when a sequence of changes ends: at the release of a key, and at the
press on an item. Use it for work that must not run on each key repeat.

props.name: count
props.description: The count of items. The default is 5.

props.name: precision
props.description:
The distance between two values. The default is 1, which gives whole items. 0.5 gives half
items. A precision below 1 makes the rating a slider, because a radio group cannot say 3.5.

props.name: allowClear
props.description:
A press on the item of the current value puts the value back to 0. `Delete` and `Backspace`
do the same. The default is on.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the rating. The items leave the tab order, and the value does not change.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the items in the tab order, but the value does not change.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the rating as necessary. The root gets `aria-required`.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the value as invalid. The root gets `aria-invalid`.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the hidden input that carries the value in a form.

props.name: form
props.description: The id of the form that the hidden input belongs to, when the rating is outside it.

props.name: getItemLabel
props.description:
The text of one item, for the screen reader. The default is "3 of 5" in the locale. The
second argument is the count.

props.name: getValueText
props.description:
The text of the value, for `Rating.Output` and for the text a screen reader reads. The
default is "3 of 5" in the locale, and "No rating" at 0.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name of the rating, for when there is no `Rating.Label`.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: The id of the element that gives the rating its name, in place of `Rating.Label`.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: The id of the element that describes the rating, for example an error message.

props.name: children
props.description: The content: the label, the output and the items.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the root element.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the root element.

props.name: context
props.description: A bindable reference to the context, for a composition of your own.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the rating is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus in the rating must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while an item, or the root, has the focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-hovering
dataAttributes.description: Present while the pointer is on the items.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present while the value is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present while the rating is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present while the rating is necessary.

parts.name: Label
parts.description: The accessible name of the rating. It renders a span, and the root points at it with aria-labelledby. A press on it puts the focus on the rating.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the label.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the rating is disabled.

parts.name: Output
parts.description: The text of the value. It renders an output element for the root, with aria-live="off". The text follows the pointer while the pointer is on the items.

props.name: children
props.description:
The content. As a snippet with one argument, it receives the render state: `value`,
`displayValue`, `count` and `text`. Without it, the component shows `text`.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the rating is disabled.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: One item of the scale, for example one star. It renders a span with role="radio", or role="presentation" at a precision below 1. The fill of the item is in --rating-item-fill.

props.name: index
props.description: The index of the item. Without it, the items take the indexes in mount order.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: The name of this item, for the screen reader. It replaces `getItemLabel` of the root.

props.name: children
props.description:
The content. As a snippet with one argument, it receives the render state: `value`, `index`,
`fill`, `selected`, `highlighted` and `focused`.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the item.

props.name: element
props.description: A bindable reference to the item element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present while the rating is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while the focus on the item must be visible (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item has the focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-highlighted
dataAttributes.description: Present while the value, or the pointer, is at this item or past it.

dataAttributes.name: data-index
dataAttributes.description: The index of the item, from 0.

dataAttributes.name: data-partial
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item is more than empty and less than full.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present while the rating is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-selected
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item is the value.

dataAttributes.name: data-value
dataAttributes.description: The value of the item, from 1.
